# pve_ceph_flag (Resource)

One cluster-wide Ceph flag (e.g. noout, noup) set or cleared by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_ceph_flag" "example" {
flag = "nobackfill"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `flag` (String) The ceph flag to update One of: `nobackfill`, `nodeep-scrub`, `nodown`, `noin`, `noout`, `norebalance`, `norecover`, `noscrub`, `notieragent`, `noup`, `pause`.

### Optional

- `value` (Boolean) The new value of the flag

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: flag (also the `terraform import` format).
